Claude Code guidance for this modern cross-platform dotfiles repository (macOS, Linux, WSL; CI/CD agent mode).

Commands:
```sh
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload
dot project init
dot ai review
dot security scan
dot metrics dashboard
dot plugin list
dot migrate status
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check                    # Full system health check
dot doctor                   # Diagnose issues
dot test run                 # Run all tests
perf-status                  # Check performance
perf-bench                   # Run benchmarks
perf-quick                   # One-command optimization
```

Layout: `bin/` (DOT CLI/utilities; `bin/dot` orchestrates `lib/cli/` libraries: `core.sh`, `ai.sh`, `security.sh`, `project.sh`, `testing.sh`); `config/`; `lib/`; `plugins/`; `scripts/`; `tests/`.

Tools are declarative in `config/tools.yaml`; profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Installation detects platforms/package managers. Shell, tmux, and Neovim use progressive tiers. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`; use `plugins/local/hello-world/` as template. Neovim: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`. Tmux: `config/tmux/tmux.conf`, `config/tmux/core.conf`; Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, `|`/`-` splits. Zsh: `config/zsh/`; fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms), with resource detection, lazy loading, caching, autosuggestions, and history management.

Adding tools: edit `config/tools.yaml`, add an appropriate group (essential, development, optional), test with `./install.sh --dry-run install standard`, then `./tests/test_runner.sh`. Plugins: copy `plugins/local/hello-world/`, implement required functions in `lib/core.sh`, define metadata in `plugin.yaml`, test with `dot plugin install <plugin-name>`.

1. Always run the full test suite: `./tests/test_runner.sh`
2. Test specific components: `dot test <component>`
3. Validate linting: shellcheck and yamllint
4. Check cross-platform compatibility

All secrets handled through `dot secret` commands. GPG/SSH management, gitleaks scanning, and global pre-commit hooks are supported. Key files include `config/gitconfig`, `config/shellcheckrc`, `config/yamllint.yml`, `install.sh`, `scripts/bootst
